subject.title: [Feature] Allow configuring Gemini safety settings in OpenClaw

question: Should OpenClaw expose a first-class Gemini safety-settings config knob, and if so what exact schema, categories, thresholds, and precedence should it support?
rationale: This changes provider request behavior and can alter upstream safety filtering, so automation should not choose the public config contract or safety posture without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve a narrow Google setting
options.body: Add a strict `models.providers.*.safetySettings` or equivalent Google-scoped contract with documented categories, thresholds, request precedence, and tests.

options.title: Keep defaults only
options.body: Decline the config surface for now and keep Gemini safety behavior on the provider defaults to avoid a new safety-affecting knob.

options.title: Route through provider API design
options.body: Pause implementation until a broader provider-specific settings seam is designed for Google and other provider-owned request options.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow Google setting
recommendation.body: Add a strict `models.providers.*.safetySettings` or equivalent Google-scoped contract with documented categories, thresholds, request precedence, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history and prior issue routing connect this handle most directly to the Google provider/config surfaces and product decision.
